name: RoboTire
long_description:
In a fleet-centric world where everything is delivered to your doorstep, cost-per-mile and uptime are all that matter. Vehicles will be driving more miles and the decreased complexity of electric motors will fundamentally change the automotive service industry. ROBOTIRE will bring manufacturing-level automation to vehicle servicing. 

Tires are the perfect vertical to tackle first because they are future-proof (tires are going nowhere) and scale from luxury personal automobiles to freight-centric big-rigs. The current tire changing industry is entrenched with an aging workforce but maintains strong margins. We will build and deploy a robotic tire changing container that can change tires in 10 minutes. 

Our fully-integrated ROBOTIRE containers can be placed inside existing shops, Walmart parking lots or in the middle of a fleet service area hundreds of miles away from a major city. In the medium term, we will expand to brakes, oil, batteries, etc. becoming an uptime assembly line that keeps fleets on the road 24/7 at a fraction of the maintenance cost per mile we see today. In a fleet-centric world, cost-per-mile and uptime are all that matter. ROBOTIRE tackles both.
one_liner: Robotire is automating vehicle maintenance for today and future…

name: Mecho Autotech
long_description:
It is cumbersome to maintain/repair vehicles in Africa. Vehicle owners currently have 2 options to choose from; very expensive and geographically limited branded mechanic garages (less than 1% of the supply pool) or unvetted roadside mechanics (about 99% of the supply pool). 

About 95% of vehicle owners cannot afford branded garages where quality and reliable service delivery can be guaranteed and thus rely on roadside mechanics. However, low quality and transparency are typical issues associated with roadside mechanics. 

We created a network of vetted mechanics, spare part vendors and an app that enables easy booking, payment and mechanic matching process. Via the mecho app, a customer or business can make a request for any automobile service (repairs or regular servicing) or part.

name: Olympian Motors
long_description:
⚡️Olympian manufactures timeless, art-deco electric vehicles. We challenge today’s mundane, over-standardized car designs produced by the traditional automotive industry.

► Olympian EVs are powered by an open, modular EV architecture. We are pioneering a new modular production model in the U.S., delivering 85–90% reductions in tooling and machinery costs, and achieved 60–80% faster production-lead-times compared to legacy automakers in the U.S.

💸 Revenue Backlog: $61M+
🚗 Number of Orders: 790+
🏭 Production Capacity: 2,400 units in 2026
✅ Backed by: YC, NVIDIA, Climate Capital, Mobility Vision, Amazon AWS, Soma & Collaborative.

--
Olympian has two pillars:
1) Art-deco, aesthetic, but simple electric cars
2) Modular EV architecture that enables rapid, cost-efficient production.

Olympian rejects today's mundane and over-standardized car experience.   We challenge the 40-year status-quo in automotive design, and bring aesthetic, simplicity and color back to the cars. 

We are manufacturing electric vehicles with our innovative 'modular' vehicle & drivetrain architecture (MVDS), providing Olympian with strong cost and lead-time advantages compared to legacy automakers like Tesla and Ford. Olympian is disrupting 120+ years old automotive industry and targeting to capture 7% market share in the U.S. automotive market by 2030.

Olympian developed a fully-decoupled, modular, EV drivetrain system (eMVDS) that provides a 'Lego-like' vehicle architecture. Built on 4-core-hardware and 2-core software modules, Olympus eMVDS platform unlocks 80% reduction in tooling & machinery costs and built ~60% faster production lead time.

launches.title: Curo: Electric fleets lease EV charging spots from owners
launches.tagline: Electric fleets park and charge anywhere with Curo.
launches.body:
👋 Hey everyone! We’re [Andrew](https://www.linkedin.com/in/andrew--porter/) and [Kieran](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kieran-luke-white/), co-founders of [Curo](http://www.curocharging.com)!

# **TL;DR**

One of the key reasons **fleets struggle to electrify** is **charging issues**, and **EV charger usage** is **painfully low**. Curo’s platform helps EV charger owners lease their charging spots during low usage times to fleets when they need them most. Curo helps **fleets electrify instantly**, at a **fraction of the cost** and **increases** **EV charger owners’** **revenue by 5x**. We work with some of the largest charging owners and fleets, helping us to **grow 100% MoM for the past 4 months.** 

<https://youtu.be/N0jcdalLpFU>

# 🤯 **Problem: Electrification faces two huge challenges**

1. 🚘 **Fleets** **(especially distributed ones)** **struggle** **to electrify at scale**: EV chargers can cost thousands of dollars and take years to install, even then installation may not be feasible due to land ownership and operating model. It’s really hard. 
2. 🔌 **EV charger usage** **and** **return on investment is painfully** **slow**: private chargers can’t be monetized due to security and liability barriers, with public chargers not being set up for long-term, exclusive use.

By 2030, there are expected to be 9 million electric vehicles in fleets, which, together with public vehicles, requires support from an estimated 40 million new EV chargers. We currently have well under 1 million installed. That’s pretty daunting.

EV chargers have to be used way more effectively for us to stand a chance at supporting millions of electric fleet vehicles.

# 🛟 **Solution: Curo - The Virtual Depot Platform**

Curo’s platform helps EV charger owners lease their charging spaces during low usage times to fleets when they need them most (picture an office building hosting a fleet overnight when employees go home).

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84703&key=user_uploads/1159251/862f55be-f893-4677-bad3-66b353890cf4)

We make it easy for fleets to identify, plan, and launch at spots they’ve leased and derisk EV charger owners sharing their assets, including legal, security, insurance, and payments.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=84703&key=user_uploads/1159251/51d0e977-5097-4a60-90b8-7461fd08d490)

Curo allows fleets to park and charge anywhere using immediately available and scalable infrastructure, with no upfront cost. We call this a "Virtual Depot” because each site has the utility of a fleet’s traditional depot, distributed in a virtual network.

# **🙏 Ask: Share this post**

* Do you know **anyone with EV chargers at a commercial property** or have an interest in installing them? We’d love to help monetize their space.
* Does a **fleet manager** come to mind? We can help them park and charge right away. 

We’ve distributed one of Tesla's largest electric fleets and worked on awesome things at DraftKings. We’re excited to be building with the YC community.

Thanks for reading!

Team Curo

We built Flai to fix this - AI assistants that answer dealership calls 24/7, scheduling test drives, oil changes, or running outbound recall campaigns so no opportunity slips away.

launches.title: Flai — We Bring Customers to Your Auto Dealership
launches.tagline: We answer the phone 24/7 and manage critical outbound communications, helping auto dealerships turn more leads into booked on-site visits.
launches.body:
**Contact:** [founders@useflai.com](mailto:founders@useflai.com)

**TL;DR**

✅ **24/7 AI assistant** that books test drives & service appointments in seconds\
✅ **Smart outbound AI assistant** that handles recalls and appointment reminders\
✅ **Plug-and-play integrations** with dealer DMS/CRM; live in stores today

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xO1TXqmllIQ

❌ **The Problem**

Dealerships are trapped in a never-ending cycle that bleeds revenue:

* **60% of dealership leads arrive after business hours** and most dealers can't answer
* **70% who hit voicemail contact a competitor within 30 minutes**, losing the sale
* **Each store loses $1M annually** from those missed calls alone
* **Staffed coverage is costly, inconsistent, and impossible to scale**

✨ **Our Solution**

Flai's Dealership-Tailored AI Assistants gives every dealership a tireless voice agent with three core capabilities:

* **Always-On Coverage:** Our AI agents answer or dial every single customer 24/7, so no inquiry or follow-up slips through the cracks
* **Multi-Channel Communications:** Calls, SMS, and email work together to book test-drives, service slots, and recall visits the moment customers are ready
* **Dealer-Ready & Secure:** Fast DMS/CRM integration, full call logs, and SOC 2 Type II compliance, built for automotive retail from day one

Dealers switch it on in an afternoon and instantly reach **100% call coverage** with zero wait time.

🛠️ **Why Now?**

The pain and the cure have finally converged.

* **There's a phone-lead crisis unfolding:** 50% of inbound calls never reach a rep, and dealerships leak $1M+ annually from poor phone coverage
* **Multiple breakthroughs in voice AI:** Agents have reached human-level fluency this year. The technology is finally ready

👥 **Backstory & Team**

Ari waited for 30min on hold while booking a service appointment and the idea clicked: unanswered phones are bleeding dealerships dry. That same weekend we dropped in on ten dealerships, got our initial prospect (which we signed a few days later), and decided then and there to solve it.

**Ari Polakof (CEO)** – Second engineer at Happyrobot (YC S23)\
**Alen Polakof (CTO)** – 4 years infra at Uber; knows how to keep systems up at scale\
**Juan Alzugaray (COO)** – ex-Netflix data scientist who turns ops pain into product

🙌 **Our Ask**

**Intros to people in the car dealership industry**, we'd love to chat ([founders@useflai.com](mailto:founders@useflai.com))
